Supplied frozen ResearchGate author-uploaded parse contains seven-page primary empirical report including methods, results, tables, discussion and references. This is the November 2, 2023 advance online version of the reference published in 2024, not a preregistration or secondary article. No PDF supplied; no rendering attempted. Supplements not supplied. Original side and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Monitoring description maps to the named consumption-monitoring row, supported by questionnaire measure on p.3 L577–584. Current-study F=1.14 is printed; requested d is not supplied for this test. Original-study F=.69 is a different column. Table gives means, SDs, CIs and F but no df or item-specific N. Unstarred F is not converted into p>.05; legend gives thresholds only for starred results. No same-test exact p or bound is printed. Methods report 654 recruited; 190 excluded (168 for discovery of purpose, 22 experimenter error). Group members were excluded if anyone inferred the purpose. Final whole-study N=464, not assumed to be item-specific analytic N. Table 2 correlation Ns are not transferred to this test. No conversion or N calculation performed.
